title: Layout, arrangement and framing
summary: Arrange objects from their measured bounds and frame the camera around the resulting composition.

blocks.text: VBox.arrange and HBox.arrange measure world bounds and reposition objects without creating a parent. Use them for objects that appear one at a time. New VBox/HBox create an Entity container and re-layout their children when added or removed. Use a container when the composition should move or fade together.

Arrange replicates a template over a line, grid, volume lattice, radial layout or curve. CPU mode gives individual scene entities and per-item APIs; GPU mode uses Instanced storage and shared geometry. Choose CPU mode for heterogeneous child interactions and GPU mode for repeated geometry with many instances. Changing a template’s topology is different from changing per-instance position or color.

Camera.frame accepts entities, an AABB or points. It computes bounds, aspect-aware distance or orthographic scale, optional orientation and focal distance. Empty bounds produce no usable framing transform. ComputeFrameTransform calculates a result without applying it, which is useful when constructing a camera animation.

Camera.frame is immediate. There is no current Camera.frameAnimated method. Animate camera.position or use camera animations; a 2D controller provides zoomToFit with its own seconds-based transition semantics.
